When Molly and Gil find a lost kitten named Bubble Kitty, they help take the cat home to Meownt Rushmore.
The Bubble Guppies head to the supermarket to shop for fruits, vegetables and a box of Bubble Bites for Bubble Puppy.

When Chefs Molly and Gil bring their tasty food truck to Bland Land, they discover that Baron von Bland only lets his subjects eat Bland Bread; the Chefs must find a way to bring taste to the kingdom.
Molly performs in the quick-change dress-up match during Fashion Week in Bubbletucky and ends up on the cover of a fashion magazine.
Excited that Zooli is getting a new pet, the Guppies try to guess what kind of animal it is; Zooli loves many creatures, so her new pet could be anything in the animal kingdom.
Oona's friend is worried about his first day of school; the guppies reveal that school is a great place to learn, play and meet new friends.

Molly and Gil meet Farmer Joe and all the cool barnyard animals on his farm; when Farmer Joe's cute baby lamb wanders off during a big swirling popcorn storm, Bubble Puppy has to become a sheepdog and herd her back to safety!
The Ocean Patrol tries to stop Windy Pete when he sails around the world and blasts tropical climates with snow.
Molly and the Guppies want to learn how to tell a story through dance.
The children try to teach Mr. Grumpfish about their favorite things when he is their substitute teacher.
The Bubble Guppies fly an airplane through the sky.
Molly helps a princess-in-training with her manners, and together they become princesses in the hallowed Glitter Games.
The Bubble Guppies must deal with a difficult customer at their restaurant.

It's lighthouse keeper Deema's birthday, but when a monster named Fogzilla keeps blowing out her lighthouse, she needs to figure out how to get Capt. Molly's ship, carrying her birthday cake to shore, or there won't be a party.

When giant robot Buster steals all the batteries that power Solar City, which runs on the sun's energy, it's up to solar power workers Nonny and Goby to stop him and get the lights back on before the big light show is cancelled.
When some untidy Titans (played by Guppies) start messing up Zooli, Nonny and Oona's goat farm, the goat herders must journey to the Titans' cloud realm to ask them to tidy up.
Gil needs to get his hair cut before picture day.
When Bubble Puppy disappears after biting an ancient magic bone, the Guppies must embark on an adventure to find him.
Deema has a loose tooth; the Guppies learn about keeping a healthy smile.
When their friend's moving day does not go as planned, Molly, Gil and the Guppy Movers head out to set things right in his new home.

When primatologists Zooli and Gil are looking in the rainforest for a silverback gorilla, they're chased into an ancient temple by a robotic silverback that turns out to be a tiny marmoset guarding a sanctuary of mountain gorillas.

It's Team Flightless versus cocky Amelia the peregrine falcon; though Penguin Nonny, Ostrich Oona, and Kiwi Goby can't fly, these birds of a feather flock together; teamwork must be enough for them to win the race.
When supervillain Felina Meow starts turning all the dogs at the annual dog show into cats, it's up to superheroes Puppy Girl and Super Pup to stop her.
City-slicker umbrella sellers Molly and Gil set up shop in the Amazon rainforest.
The Guppies help a friendly pirate search for treasure using a map.
The Bubble Guppies learn about construction while building a doghouse for Bubble Puppy.
Deema must turn over a new leaf and try broccoli if she wants to earn her broccoli badge at scout troop initiation.

When showman Gil's real live dragon (actually a Komodo dragon) gets loose in the small town of Bubbleville, it's up to Pet Finders Oona and Zooli to track the lizard down and return it to its home on Komodo Island.
The Guppies are excited for China's Lunar New Year Festival, where they will operate a giant festival dragon in the grand parade.
The Guppies prepare for a game of fishketball by practicing bouncing, throwing, catching and playing together as a team.
